summary: copyparty is a Python self-hosted file sharing/upload server: a virtual filesystem over host directories, a per-volume SQLite file index (up/mt/ds/iu/cv/dh/kv tables) built by rescan and updated on every upload/delete/move/copy, a sessions DB, a share DB (Sh/Sf), a chpw password store, HTTP multipart/json/binary upload plus WebDAV/WebSocket interfaces

_no_edges.why: aborts an in-flight broker copy/move by akey (up2k.handle_fs_abrt); persists no row, only cancellation flag; config-toggled --no_fs_abrt, no DB wall, calls nothing

system-internal background rescan reindex driven by the upload/change pipeline (up2k._hasher); permission-less internal worker; its tag enqueue feed the same tagged worker rather than a separate user op
